verdict.rationale: Datadog's API docs refer to an official "Datadog API collection" for Postman, which is a first-party, machine-readable API description close to an OpenAPI equivalent. However, the evidence never documents an OpenAPI/Swagger file or a download location, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The markdown version of the API reference page is human-oriented, not a spec. missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file with a URL, confirmation of the spec's coverage and versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: add your Datadog API and Application key values to the **Collection variables** of the Datadog API collection.
